name: Voxel Diorama Renderer
author: PRISMATIC
description: Reference graphics mod: lifts a flat GBC overworld into a tilted 2.5D voxel diorama (gen1recomp / DramaticShape look). Bakes each map cell into a heightfield with shaped archetypes — gable-roofed buildings with overhanging eaves and recessed doors, domed trees and rocks, terraced ledges, rippling water — then grounds everything with contact shadows and finishes with a daytime colour grade, bloom and vignette pass.
